TaskDescription: Resting-state EEG recorded in alternating eyes-closed and eyes-open conditions in 1-minute blocks (about 4 minutes per condition in total). During the eyes-open condition a white fixation cross was presented on a grey background. A prerecorded voice gave commands to open and close the eyes every minute; the stimuli were presented in PsychoPy. Triggers: S20 = start of a 1-minute eyes-closed block, S21 = start of a 1-minute eyes-open block; S254/S252 = start/end of the resting-state recording.
